tactics: No Upfront Cost: Highlight that we build a free working demo site/agent first, so they see the value before paying anything.
High ROI: An AI receptionist answers 100% of missed calls instantly, saving average local businesses 10+ hours a week and preventing booking loss.
Low Hosting Cost: Explain that Next.js hosting on Vercel is free/extremely cheap, avoiding recurring legacy developer fees.

Live iPhone Call Test: Offer to configure a test number so they can call the AI agent from their phone and test the realism directly.

Traffic Capture: Modern Next.js pages can be hosted on a subdomain (e.g. book.theirsite.com) purely for customer booking campaigns.
